screens.S_ENTRY: Launcher / outside the process (app not running, or reopened from the background)
screens.S_MAIN_PAUSED: Main is paused/stopped in the back stack: the app is in the background (Home / recents / screen off) or Chart/Help/Settings is on top; the process is still alive
screens.S_CHART_PAUSED: ChartActivity is paused/stopped in the back stack (Home / ChoiceDialog opened / mid-rotation)
screens.S_MAIN_DISPLAY: Main page, DISPLAY_MODE: action bar = main.xml (Add/Refresh inline, Update/Help/Settings under More options)
screens.S_MAIN_SELECT: Main page, SELECT_MODE: some rows highlighted; action bar = select.xml (Clear/Remove/Chart/Copy)
screens.S_MAIN_EDIT: Main page, the value EditText at the top has focus and the soft keyboard is shown
screens.S_DLG_UPDATE: AlertDialog "Update extra currency" over Main (EditText + OK/Cancel)
screens.S_CHOICE_DISPLAY: ChoiceDialog (floating activity), nothing selected: Clear/Select buttons disabled, tapping a row returns immediately
screens.S_CHOICE_SELECT: ChoiceDialog in multi-select: Clear/Select buttons enabled
screens.S_CHART_LOADING: ChartActivity, histMap==null (downloading / no network): Invert menu item disabled
screens.S_CHART_LOADED: ChartActivity, histMap!=null (line chart drawn): Invert menu item enabled
screens.S_DLG_DIGITS: Single-choice dialog of the "Fraction digits" ListPreference in Settings
screens.S_DLG_ABOUT: Dialog opened by the About preference (AboutPreference) in Settings (layout about.xml)
screens.S_EXIT: Main finished (Back) or process killed: the next start is a cold start
